name: God's Continent
detailed_description:
Join us


About the Game

The meteorite from outer space, like a ray of death light, cut through the vast starry sky and fell heavily to the Kalia continent. The huge impact force generated by its explosion, like a raging tsunami, almost swept the entire continent. This disaster not only brought material destruction, but also awakened the seven ancient demon kings sleeping in the forgotten land. Their awakening broke the balance of the world, and the Kalia continent instantly fell into the abyss of darkness, and a world-destroying catastrophe was about to come. At this moment of life and death, the legendary son of God came to this world with a mission. He will reunite the power of light, courage, and hope, fight a desperate battle with the dark forces, and fight to restore peace to the world. ​

The hero professions in the game are rich and diverse, with 6 major professions: Berserker, Mage, Shooter, Assassin, Shield Warrior, and Sacrifice, each with its own unique characteristics. Berserker, with powerful melee output ability, is like a meat grinder on the battlefield; Mage, who controls the power of elements, can cause high spell damage to the enemy at a long distance; Shooter, with superb archery skills, fast attack speed and high hit rate; Assassin, with quick shots, good at stealth and burst, can give the enemy a fatal blow in an instant; Shield Warrior, is a solid barrier for the team, with strong defense ability and health value to effectively protect teammates; Sacrifice, is the life guarantee of the team, with super strong healing and gain capabilities. ​

Before the battle begins, players can clearly see the enemy's information and position, so as to adjust the position and lineup in a targeted manner. The victory conditions and requirements in different battle scenes are different. Players need to pay attention to the battle prompts, the order of killing the opponent's monsters, and other requirements to achieve a perfect clearance. ​

Hero skill matching is also a highlight. Unlike conventional card mobile games, the hero skills here can be released manually by the player, and heroes with different attributes can stack different skill buffs, which can produce completely different effects. If you get stuck in a battle, you may find the key to a breakthrough by studying the effects of hero skills and releasing them in a reasonable combination. ​​

The hero development system is rich and in-depth. Players can use experience potions to increase hero experience, help heroes improve their ability levels, comprehend new skills and passive characteristics of skills, and use breakthrough gems to unlock new skills when they reach a certain level. In addition, the resources required for each level and rank upgrade and the effects after the upgrade are clearly informed to the players, so that players can accurately estimate the overall improvement and allocate development resources in a targeted manner. ​

Each hero has an independent equipment system and rune system. Different heroes with different runes can change the basic combat attributes of the hero, adding variability to the linear hero development mode.

The game uses advanced graphics technology and high-end physics engines to create a colorful magical world. The characters and scenes are beautifully designed, whether it is an ancient European castle, a grassland in the wilderness, a mysterious cave, or a snow-covered mountain, they are all lifelike. The full-process sound effects output and the soft and sweet voice-overs of the beautiful girls bring players an immersive gaming experience. During the battle, the natural and smooth fighting movements and the gorgeous and cool skill effects make people excited.

short_description: "God's Continent" is a strategy card game. You will enter a magical world full of fantasy and adventure. Along the way, you can form a powerful team of your own among the three races of humans, beasts and demons, and embark on the road to fight against darkness.
supported_languages: English, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
